# Nam

> Personal notes and writing.

This is Nam's Markdown blog. Pages are static HTML built with Material for
MkDocs. The source is Markdown in https://github.com/namndinh/blog/.

Public agents can search and fetch posts through the MCP server. Creating or
updating a post requires a bearer token and opens a draft pull request. A
human still merges and sets `draft: false` before anything goes live. You can
also clone the repo and open a pull request yourself.

## Writing

- [Writing](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/writing/): post index
- [The Human + Agent Ready Checklist](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/writing/2026/09/06/the-human-agent-ready-checklist/): seven checks for agent-ready products
- [How this blog works](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/writing/2026/09/06/how-this-blog-works/): how to clone the repo and contribute
- [RSS of new posts](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/feed_rss_created.xml)
- [RSS of updated posts](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/feed_rss_updated.xml)

## For agents

- [Search index](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/search/search_index.json): JSON documents for full-text search
- [Agent manifest](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/api/agent-manifest.json): feeds, search index, MCP
- [MCP](https://nam-blog-mcp.namndinh.workers.dev/mcp): public `search`, `get_details`, `list_authors`; writes need a token
- [Sitemap](https://namndinh.github.io/blog/sitemap.xml)
- [Source](https://github.com/namndinh/blog/)

Reads are public. Writes go through MCP as draft PRs, or through GitHub
directly. There is no login or checkout on the site itself.
